_doc: Distance/similarity metrics, by hand (stdlib). pair = two frozen D=4 integer vectors with l2, dot, cosine, the two norms and normalizedDot (= cosine). disagree = a pair where L2 and cosine pick DIFFERENT candidates. ranking = 1 query, 3 candidates whose top-1 differs under L2 vs cosine vs inner-product. The lesson: the metric choice changes the answer.
_source: _research/gen_l9.py (toy, stdlib): exact integer-vector arithmetic, rounded to 4 places.

disagree.note: L2 prefers the nearer-but-misaligned p1; cosine prefers the aligned-but-farther p2 — rankings flip.

ranking.note: L2 → nearest displacement; cosine → best alignment; inner-product → largest magnitude·alignment.
